title: Internal hours with no default labor rate at any contributing location show an em-dash with the correct assistive-technology label
custom_preconds: 1. A technician's in-range internal hours were all clocked at location(s) with NO default labor rate configured (rate absent, not $0.00).
custom_steps:
1. Read that technician's Est. Lost Labor.
2. Inspect the cell with a screen reader or the accessibility tree.
custom_expected:
1. Est. Lost Labor shows "—" (an em-dash), NOT "$0.00" - the rate is unknown, so the value cannot be computed.
2. The "—" cell carries the assistive-technology label "No default labor rate configured" (distinguishing it from "$0.00", which reads as its dollar value).
3. The technician's Internal Hours column still shows all the internal hours (they are counted even though they cannot be valued).
